convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load '3XMA_Ishimoku' custom indicator with 18 parameters, and depends on two external .mqh libraries (SmoothAlgorithms.mqh for averaging classes and TradeAlgorithms.mqh for trading functions). Custom indicator logic cannot be auto-converted without reimplementing the indicator.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars for indicator calculation
TimeShiftSec - chart period in seconds
derived_values.used_by: Signal time calculation for UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime

other_exits: Long position closed when sell signal detected (XmaValue < min(UpValue, DnValue))
Short position closed when buy signal detected (XmaValue > max(UpValue, DnValue))

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MM parameter: negative values represent fixed lot size (abs value), positive values represent deposit share fraction. Default -0.1 means 0.1 fixed lots.

custom_logic_notes: Entry logic uses previous bar [1] values for condition check and bar [0] for confirmation: Buy signal when XmaValue[1] > max(UpValue[1], DnValue[1]) AND XmaValue[0] <= max(UpValue[0], DnValue[0]). Sell signal when XmaValue[1] < min(UpValue[1], DnValue[1]) AND XmaValue[0] >= min(UpValue[0], DnValue[0]). The SignalBar input (default 1) allows shifting which bar is used for signal generation. When SignalBar=0, signals are evaluated on every tick instead of only on new bars. Separate boolean inputs control buy/sell entry permissions and long/short close permissions independently. The 3XMA_Ishimoku indicator is a triple smoothed moving average system with Ishimoku-style upper/lower channels derived from high/low price extremes across three periods.
python_conversion_notes: Requires full reimplementation of 3XMA_Ishimoku custom indicator in Python. The indicator uses three XMA (extended moving average) smoothing passes with configurable methods (SMA, EMA, SMMA, LWMA, JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA) from SmoothAlgorithms.mqh - each smoothing method (especially JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA) must be reimplemented. TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen/BuyPositionClose/SellPositionClose functions and CIsNewBar class - these must also be reimplemented. The MM parameter dual-mode sizing (negative=lot, positive=deposit fraction) must be preserved. Signal logic uses cross of XMA line above/below the channel formed by max/min of upper and lower Ishimoku lines.
